description: Source code for Zephyr OS settings backend using Flash Circular Buffer (FCB), including initialization, load, save, and management functions.

methods.name: settings_backend_init
methods.description: Initializes the FCB backend, sets up sectors, and handles formatting if necessary.

methods.name: settings_fcb_src
methods.description: Initializes the settings source with FCB, erasing sectors if needed.

methods.name: settings_fcb_dst
methods.description: Registers the settings destination with FCB.

methods.name: settings_fcb_get_flash_area
methods.description: Weak function to get the flash area ID; can be overridden by user.

methods.name: settings_fcb_storage_get
methods.description: Returns pointer to the FCB structure for storage access.
